links.outcome: DKD detection AUC on internal validation versus ten external multi-ethnic validation datasets
links.effect: AUC 0·842 (95% CI 0·838-0·846) on internal validation and 0·791-0·826 across external validation datasets from China, Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, and the UK.
links.quote: For detecting DKD, DeepDKD achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0·842 (95% CI 0·838-0·846) on the internal validation dataset and AUCs of 0·791-0·826 across external validation datasets.

links.outcome: Sensitivity for detecting DKD, DeepDKD versus a metadata-only model, in a prospective study
links.effect: DeepDKD detected DKD with higher sensitivity than the metadata model (89·8% vs 66·3%, p<0·0001).
links.quote: In the prospective study, compared with the metadata model, DeepDKD could detect DKD with higher sensitivity (89·8% vs 66·3%, p<0·0001).

screen.reason: The study develops and validates a deep learning system (DeepDKD) for diagnosing diabetic kidney disease from retinal images, including evaluation in a prospective real-world study, but focuses on diagnostic performance rather than testing a specific deployment safeguard or workflow practice.
